scenarios.title: Balanced investment
scenarios.description: Balances population pressure, ageing, income, social security and access to daily services.

scenarios.title: Healthy ageing
scenarios.description: Prioritises older residents, access to primary care and daily necessities, and socioeconomic vulnerability.

scenarios.title: Family access
scenarios.description: Prioritises children, school access, single-parent households, low income and access to daily groceries.

scenarios.title: Social vulnerability
scenarios.description: Emphasises low income, benefit dependency, single-parent households and low average household income.

scenarios.title: Service pressure
scenarios.description: Emphasises population pressure and distance to health, food, school and rail services.
